meta.title: Understanding how you prepare similar trials
meta.topic:
We are looking at how field officers prepare proposals for trials that are similar to previous trials.

We would like to understand which parts of your work are repeated, which need changing, and which need to be prepared from scratch.

Your answers will help us understand your current ways of working and identify where improvements might be possible. This survey does not mean that any particular feature will be developed.

Please answer based on your usual work across all your trials, not just your most recent trial.

Estimated time: 5 minutes.
meta.thanks: Thank you for your time and feedback.
